description: The file defines an internal interface and a sealed class implementing gateway notification handling for Orleans clients, specifically related to observing and managing gateway communication.

classes.name: ClientGatewayObserver
classes.description: A sealed class that observes client gateway communication and manages gateway availability within Orleans.

methods.name: StopSendingToGateway
methods.description: Signals the gateway to stop sending messages to a specified gateway address.

methods.name: GetObserverGrainId
methods.description: Generates an observer grain ID for a given client ID.

methods.name: GetObserver
methods.description: Retrieves the observer grain instance for a specific client ID using the internal grain factory.
